chunks.text:
[Turnaround]
{a short turnaround that leads smoothly straight back into the main theme, same tempo and key}
positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
3/4 time with a slow half-time feel
a solo cello playing the hymn in long held fragments
a soft pipe organ holding a continuous low drone under every bar
a single high glass bell now and then, like a thin seam of light
a slow clockwork tick once a bar
solemn, elegiac, grieving, quiet and close
strong singable melody, instantly hummable and pleasant on repeat
seamless transition back to the theme
